note: Defects observed in a real delivery, each pinned to a fixture and a detector command. A case here is decided by running one command and comparing codes: no agent, no judge, no credits. That is deliberate — for a mechanically decided case, 'optimising for the test' and 'fixing the defect' are the same action, which is the only place in this loop where reward hacking has no room. Behaviour cases that need a judge stay in behavior-cases.json and carry a weaker evidence level.

cases.statement: A mode-dispatching factory declared its return type with the stage parameter instantiated as never, so the public type admitted no registration at all. Every existing gate passed the document: validate, repo-facts and reading-receipt were clean, and the contract recorded CONVERGED with SYNTHESIS, ADVERSARIAL and ACCEPTANCE_TOPOLOGY all PASS.
cases.root_cause: No step in the authoring pipeline read the `**Signatures:**` fence as types. repo-facts.ts:134-145 extracts import specifiers from it and nothing else; PSEUDOCODE_SYMBOL_UNRESOLVED is a regular-expression candidate that never blocks.

evidence.quote: export function createPipeline<TValue>(mode: IMiddlewarePipelineMode, options: IMiddlewarePipelineHostOptions): IMiddlewarePipelineHost<TValue, never>
evidence.why_it_compiles: Method parameters are bivariant, so the implementation returning a concrete host is still assignable to the declared return type. The defect is reachable only at a call site: `p.use(stage)` compares an argument against a parameter of type never, where no bivariance applies.

observed_baseline.note: 75 documents carry no New/Changed API & Typing section at all, so the probe's reach over this corpus is 8 documents. That is a fact about the corpus, not about the detector, and it bounds any claim made from this baseline.

cases.statement: The contract claims CONVERGED while a blocking finding is still recorded.
The contract claims CONVERGED with the ADVERSARIAL lens absent from review_passes.
A batch lists a requirement ID the contract never defines.
A gate row exists in the delivery table but is missing from the presentation index.
ownership.packages names a package no batch writes, and omits the one PC01 does write. `validate` accepts this document; only the derived contract check reports it.
cases.note: This case exists because the perturbation probe found `validate` silent on it. It is the first case whose detector is the derived-contract check rather than the validator, which is the evidence that generation adds coverage rather than only removing writing.

cases.statement: An acceptance claim quantified UNIVERSAL carries no `universe`, so the set it quantifies over is undeclared. `validate` accepted this until the check below existed: the universe was required only for zero-reader migration claims, and a universal claim anywhere else had nothing asking for it.
cases.note: The negative fixture supplies the universe rather than dropping the quantifier, so the case turns on the missing field and not on the claim being universal at all.

cases.source_delivery: create-sdd worked example against a fixture workspace
cases.statement: An acceptance method runs `npm` against a package whose workspace declares pnpm. The command would resolve a different tree than the one the design was checked against, and nothing else in the document says which manager is authoritative.
cases.why_this_case_exists: `COMMAND_PACKAGE_MANAGER_MISMATCH` had never fired across 444 observations, and 1016 lines of `managers.ts` plus `package-manager.test.ts` exist to serve it and one sibling code. The audit could not tell a dead rule from a rule whose defect this corpus never contains. This case answers that by running it: the code fires on the mismatch and stays silent on the match, so the rule discriminates and the silence was the corpus, not the rule.

cases.source_delivery: create-sdd worked example against a fixture workspace
cases.statement: An acceptance environment names pnpm 8.1 while the workspace pins pnpm 9.0.0 through `packageManager`. The acceptance would run under a toolchain the repository does not use, so a PASS would be evidence about a different environment than the one shipped.
cases.why_this_case_exists: Same reason as CSDD-MANAGER-101: `TOOLCHAIN_VERSION_CONFLICT` had never fired, and the two codes share the same 1016 lines of assets. Both now have a minimal contrast, so a future round can retire either one against evidence instead of against the raw never-fired count.

cases.statement: The contract claims CONVERGED while the ADVERSARIAL and ACCEPTANCE_TOPOLOGY lenses have no recorded pass. Only the lens that agreed with the design was applied.

cases.source_delivery: promoted from the mechanical half of behaviour case CSDD-CONVERGENCE-001
cases.statement: The contract claims CONVERGED while an unresolved information question is still listed. The question is work the author owns; carrying it forward is the third ending the handoff rules forbid.
cases.promoted_from: CSDD-CONVERGENCE-001 (its mechanical half only; the case itself stays, because its other half is that the reply must not claim LOOP_READY, which no command can decide)

cases.statement: A complete sdd/v2 leaf validated outside any git checkout (a draft written to a temporary directory) is BLOCKED by REPOSITORY_NOT_FOUND, although the skill supports authoring without the repository and only limits the claims.
cases.root_cause: Repository auto-detection failure was reported as a diagnostic; the evidence limit 'Repository location is unverified' could therefore never appear on a valid result.
cases.source_delivery: create-sdd v2 upgrade evaluation (working tree vs e55de9a)

cases.statement: A traceability table row that starts with an already defined requirement ID is counted as a second normative definition, so the document is BLOCKED by SDD_V2_PROSE_DEFINITION_DUPLICATE (reported twice for one ID).
cases.root_cause: definitionCount treats heading, list and table-row anchors as equal; the single-document Module origin check re-counts the same requirement.
cases.source_delivery: create-sdd v2 upgrade evaluation (working tree vs e55de9a)

cases.statement: A one-document sdd/v2 leaf must restate every requirement, batch and the document itself as Module, Chunk and Bundle Meta records; omitting the mirror is BLOCKED although every relation is derivable from the index.
cases.root_cause: checkV2MetaGraph requires an explicit metas array even when the leaf is its own only owner.
cases.source_delivery: create-sdd v2 upgrade evaluation (working tree vs e55de9a)

cases.statement: A [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: D1 ...] marker in the prose whose decision is absent from unresolved_user_decisions leaves the document STRUCTURALLY_READY, so an open question reaches the host silently.
cases.root_cause: Only IDs listed in unresolved_user_decisions are checked; prose markers are not read.
cases.source_delivery: create-sdd v2 upgrade evaluation (working tree vs e55de9a)

cases.statement: A Bundle reads entry naming a repository path that does not exist is accepted, so the handoff tells the host to read input that is not there.
cases.root_cause: Bundle reads are checked for form and escape only, never for existence, even when the repository is known.
cases.source_delivery: create-sdd v2 upgrade evaluation (working tree vs e55de9a)

cases.statement: A document that explains the clarification syntax in inline code (`[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: <id> ...]`) is BLOCKED by SDD_V2_CLARIFICATION_UNTRACKED although it contains no open question.
cases.root_cause: The marker scan skips fenced code only; inline code spans are read as prose.

held_out_note: Moved to cases/held-out/. `rsi.ts suite` does not read them; `rsi.ts evaluate` runs them apart from the rest, so a round has one result its work was not aimed at.

open_findings.statement: Eight defect classes observed while executing plugin-host-r1.sdd.md batch by batch; all eight passed every current check.
open_findings.next: OD-03, OD-04 and OD-07 are mechanical and cheap — cases first. OD-02 needs the type probe extended to step pseudocode. OD-06 needs B3 structure. OD-01 and OD-05 are rulings before rules.
